home.tagline: A quiet space to reflect on what is weighing on your heart.

topic.heading: What is weighing on your heart?
topic.subheading: Choose the area that feels most present right now.

concern.heading: Describe what is on your mind.
concern.subheading: Up to 300 characters. No one else will see this.
concern.placeholder: Write what you are carrying right now…
concern.crisisBanner: We noticed something that sounds painful. If you are going through something serious, please consider reaching out to a crisis helpline or emergency services in your area. You can find local resources at findahelpline.com.

emotion.heading: How are you feeling right now?
emotion.subheading: Choose the feeling that is most present.

ritual.heading: A moment before we begin.
ritual.prompt:
Close your eyes for a moment.
Take one slow breath.
Hold in your mind what you wrote.
When you feel ready, draw your Symbol.

draw.heading: Draw your Symbol
draw.instruction: Tap any card to reveal your Symbol for today.

reading.safetyFooter: Heart Symbol is a reflection tool, not a medical, psychological, legal, or financial service. If you are in crisis or need professional support, please reach out to a qualified professional or a crisis helpline in your area.
reading.legalFooter: Heart Symbol is for personal reflection only. It is not a substitute for professional medical, psychological, legal, or financial advice.

history.heading: My Readings
history.empty: You have not saved any readings yet.

errors.localStorageUnavailable: Your device does not support local saving. Your reading will not be saved.
errors.localStorageFull: Your saved readings are full. Please delete an older reading to save this one.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Starting a new reading.

ai.error: Could not personalize. Showing original reading.
ai.unavailable: AI personalization is not configured on this deployment.

home.tagline: 一个安静的空间，让你回望心中所挂念的事。

topic.heading: 你心里在挂念什么？
topic.subheading: 选择此刻最困扰你的领域。

concern.heading: 说说你现在的困惑。
concern.subheading: 最多 300 字。只有你能看到。
concern.crisisBanner: 我们注意到你分享的内容听起来很沉重。如果你正处于危机中，请联系当地的危机热线或紧急救助服务。你可以在 findahelpline.com 查找当地资源。

emotion.heading: 你现在的感受是？
emotion.subheading: 选择此刻最强烈的情绪。

ritual.heading: 在开始之前，停留片刻。
ritual.prompt:
闭上眼睛片刻。
缓缓呼吸一次。
把你写下的那些话放在心里。
当你准备好了，就来抽取你的心符。

draw.heading: 抽取你的心符
draw.instruction: 轻触任意一张牌，揭示今日的心符。

reading.safetyFooter: 心符是一款冥想和自我反思工具，不是医疗、心理健康、法律或财务服务。如果你正处于危机中或需要专业支持，请联系当地的专业人员或危机热线。
reading.legalFooter: 心符仅供个人冥想与反思，不能替代专业的医疗、心理、法律或财务建议。

history.heading: 我的心符记录
history.empty: 你还没有保存任何记录。

historyDetail.deleteConfirm: 永久删除这条心符记录？

errors.localStorageUnavailable: 你的设备不支持本地保存。此次记录将无法保存。
errors.localStorageFull: 本地存储已满。请删除旧记录以保存新的心符。
errors.sessionExpired: 当前会话已结束，即将开始新的心符。

ai.error: 个性化失败，正在显示原始解读。
ai.unavailable: 此部署未配置 AI 个性化功能。
